description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions for secure file opening and path lookup on Linux systems, utilizing the openat2 system call with specific resolve flags.

methods.name: openat2
methods.description: Opens a file relative to a directory file descriptor using openat2 with special resolve flags, handling RESOLVE_IN_ROOT cases.

methods.name: lookupOpenat2
methods.description: Performs a path lookup within a root directory, either directly or via partial lookup.

methods.name: partialLookupOpenat2
methods.description: Implements a binary search approach to find the deepest existing child in a path within a root directory using openat2.
